profile.headline: Freelance Software developer
profile.summary: Hardworking engineer with 11 years of experience leading development teams to deliver large-volume, mission-critical software that maximizes the efficiency and effectiveness of processes and organizations. Strong communicator passionate about strategic planning, problem-solving, and equitably collaborating with various stakeholders and collaborators. Innovative architect with expertise in translating business requirements into technical solutions. Skilled in all phases of the software development lifecycle and dedicated to quality, scalability, and simplicity.

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description:
Development:
 - I dealt mostly in Java with Spring Boot for APIs
 - I was required to do some ReactJS occasionally
 - Both SQL and NoSQL

Architecture:
 - I worked with both Quesing models (orchestration)  and Broker models (choreography)
 - Mostly, I have worked with REST Architectures, but I have also worked with Space/Tuple Based.
 - I am also versed in both service and data mesh structure

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented a repeatable build solution for local development environments
- Created an automated billing calculation system
- Helping to put together both feature flagging and fearless delivery system
 - Implemented the first inclusion of frontend testing with the render function in Jest

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Modernized project tooling and development workflow
- Set up a Git server and introduced a software-versioning workflow
- Implemented CI/CD workflow using Jenkins and Nexus

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Architecture:
- Architected an API-based, service-oriented presentation layer separate from our existing monolithic CMS to accelerate future development with industry best practices for tooling, CI/CD, and design patterns such as frontend for backend microservices
- Features built-in the new system created a million dollars in new revenue within a month of its release
- Designed a Backend for a Frontend solution

Project Management:
- Planned and executed the migration of 30 daily newspaper websites to a new platform, including software development, configuration management, and data migration
- Prepared detailed documentation of launch-day tasks, continuously incorporating process improvements from successive launches.
- Directed launch-day orchestration and communication between the development team, DevOps engineers, project managers, and journalists

Other Contributions:
- Implemented integration with AWS for the Elastic Transcoder, S3, and CloudFront
- Helped evolve the team’s nascent Agile processes

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed workflows for better communication between software and hardware specialists
- Gathered requirements and developed an in-house inventory system
- Maintained architecture standards in new feature development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Theorized and designed a versatile message bus for long-running, fault-tolerant, concurrent data processing, reducing complexity and increasing capacity
- Redesigned the relationship between the front and backend
- Created a HIPPA-approved authentication system with a privacy-first design

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Helped conceive, create, and launch a Q&A system to allow organizations to build open support communities
- - Created the messaging system
- - Created the admin analytic page
- - Helped with the AWS configuration
- Implemented new server and client functionalities for DZone Links built with Spring/Java and Hibernate

positions.title: R&D Intern
positions.description:
I participated in developing a dynamic RIA application that was being considered for full production.  I was responsible for unit and manually testing the product.  This internship was awarded because of our exemplary work on our senior project.  More information is given below in the Academic Projects section of this resume.

Details:
 - We used Adobe’s LiveCycle Rights Management API to dynamically gather information about actions that were taking place inside the LiveCycle server.
 - The data obtained was condensed into a format that was easier for the user to digest.
 - The Apache server technology CXF was used to access the LiveCycle API.
 - Adobe’s “Flex 3” RIA technology was used for the client-side web application.

educations.schoolName: North Carolina State UniversityCollege of Engineering
